sources.title: Abstract Interpretation: A Unified Lattice Model for Static Analysis of Programs by Construction or Approximation of Fixpoints
sources.authors: Patrick Cousot and Radhia Cousot
sources.mechanism: Ordered abstract domains connect simplified program properties to concrete semantics; abstraction must preserve soundness, not merely resemblance.
sources.limitation: Applies when a concrete semantics and sound abstraction operators are supplied; arbitrary LLM summaries do not inherit these guarantees.
sources.access: Author summary and original bibliographic entry inspected

sources.title: Formal Concept Analysis: Mathematical Foundations
sources.authors: Bernhard Ganter and Rudolf Wille
sources.mechanism: Object-attribute contexts induce extents, intents and a concept lattice, supporting non-tree hierarchies.
sources.limitation: A lattice reflects the supplied incidence relation; it does not establish that observed attributes are correct or causally meaningful.
sources.access: Publisher description and metadata inspected; book not read in full

sources.title: On the Criteria To Be Used in Decomposing Systems into Modules
sources.authors: David L. Parnas
sources.mechanism: Module boundaries should be understood as design decisions rather than assumed to coincide with an execution sequence.
sources.limitation: A source-tree decomposition is not by itself an ontology or a scheduling proof.
sources.access: Publisher abstract/metadata and university bibliographic page inspected; attempted full-text URL returned 403

sources.title: A Behavioral Notion of Subtyping
sources.authors: Barbara H. Liskov and Jeannette M. Wing
sources.mechanism: Behavioral subtyping constrains properties, specifications, invariants and histories; identical method names are insufficient.
sources.limitation: Ontology subsumption alone is not a proof of behavioral substitutability.
sources.access: Full paper inspected, especially introduction and specification conditions
sources.venue: ACM Transactions on Programming Languages and Systems

sources.title: An Axiomatic Basis for Computer Programming
sources.authors: C. A. R. Hoare
sources.mechanism: Pre/postcondition reasoning provides a basis for explicit obligations on agent-produced program changes.
sources.limitation: A passing finite test set is not a universal program proof; termination needs a separate obligation.
sources.access: Scanned PDF and indexed primary-source passage inspected; local text extraction unusable

sources.title: An Overview of OntoClean
sources.authors: Nicola Guarino and Christopher A. Welty
sources.mechanism: Identity, rigidity and unity constrain taxonomic modeling; roles and stable kinds require different treatment.
sources.limitation: Metaproperties require domain judgment; this is not an automatic validator of arbitrary source-code concepts.
sources.access: Revised chapter full text inspected; original 2004 and revised 2009 author pages checked

sources.title: Modular Reuse of Ontologies: Theory and Practice
sources.authors: Bernardo Cuenca Grau and Ian Horrocks and Yevgeny Kazakov and Ulrike Sattler
sources.mechanism: Conservative extension and locality-based modules formalize safe vocabulary reuse.
sources.limitation: General conservative-extension problems can be undecidable in expressive settings; a neighborhood is not automatically a logical module.
sources.access: Full paper inspected, especially definitions and computability qualifications

sources.title: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Profiles (Second Edition)
sources.authors: {World Wide Web Consortium}
sources.mechanism: EL, QL and RL trade expressive features for specific computational properties.
sources.limitation: Profile-specific complexity bounds do not imply low end-to-end latency; profiles are not interchangeable.
sources.access: Full text or normative specification inspected

sources.title: OWL 2 Web Ontology Language Direct Semantics (Second Edition)
sources.authors: {World Wide Web Consortium}
sources.mechanism: Model-theoretic entailment and consistency define the logical interpretation of OWL ontologies.
sources.limitation: Open-world reasoning must not be mistaken for application-level completeness or validation.
sources.access: Full text or normative specification inspected

sources.title: SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
sources.authors: {World Wide Web Consortium}
sources.mechanism: Broader/narrower concepts and mapping relations support knowledge organization without asserting class equivalence.
sources.limitation: skos:broader is not declared transitive; broaderTransitive is separate, and broader does not mean OWL subclass.
sources.access: Full text or normative specification inspected

sources.title: Shapes Constraint Language (SHACL)
sources.authors: {World Wide Web Consortium}
sources.mechanism: Shape validation checks a data graph against declared constraints.
sources.limitation: Conformance is validation under selected shapes, not proof of real-world truth or arbitrary logical consistency.
sources.access: Full text or normative specification inspected

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.authors: {World Wide Web Consortium}
sources.mechanism: Entities, activities, agents and derivation relations support interoperable provenance.
sources.limitation: Provenance records origin and process, not reliability, independence or truth.
sources.access: Full text or normative specification inspected

sources.title: The Contract Net Protocol: High-Level Communication and Control in a Distributed Problem Solver
sources.authors: Reid G. Smith
sources.mechanism: Task announcement, bidding and award separate task allocation from problem solving.
sources.limitation: A allocation protocol does not make worker outputs semantically correct.
sources.access: Publisher metadata and original-paper bibliographic record inspected; no complete IEEE full text

sources.title: Blackboard Systems: The Blackboard Model of Problem Solving and the Evolution of Blackboard Architectures
sources.authors: H. Penny Nii
sources.mechanism: Shared structured problem state can coordinate specialized knowledge sources.
sources.limitation: Modern provenance and ontology governance are additional design obligations.
sources.access: Publisher abstract and bibliographic metadata inspected

sources.title: Conflict-free Replicated Data Types
sources.authors: Marc Shapiro and Nuno Pregui{\c c}a and Carlos Baquero and Marek Zawirski
sources.mechanism: Join-semilattice state, monotone updates and eventual delivery support replica convergence.
sources.limitation: Convergence of records does not imply consistency of their logical interpretation.
sources.access: Full INRIA report RR-7687 inspected, including convergence assumptions

sources.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
sources.authors: Darren Edge and Ha Trinh and Newman Cheng and Joshua Bradley and Alex Chao and Apurva Mody and Steven Truitt and Dasha Metropolitansky and Robert Osazuwa Ness and Jonathan Larson
sources.mechanism: Hierarchical community detection and summaries support global, query-focused summarization.
sources.limitation: Community membership is topical structure, not a certified subclass relation.
sources.access: Version 2 full HTML inspected; revised February 19, 2025

sources.title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
sources.authors: Bernal Jim{\'e}nez Guti{\'e}rrez and Yiheng Shu and Yu Gu and Michihiro Yasunaga and Yu Su
sources.mechanism: Knowledge graphs and Personalized PageRank integrate evidence across retrieved passages.
sources.limitation: Associative relevance scores are not entailment or calibrated confidence.
sources.access: Full NeurIPS paper inspected
sources.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37

sources.title: AutoGen: Enabling Next-Gen LLM Applications via Multi-Agent Conversation
sources.authors: Qingyun Wu and Gagan Bansal and Jieyu Zhang and Yiran Wu and Beibin Li and Erkang Zhu and Li Jiang and Xiaoyun Zhang and Shaokun Zhang and Jiale Liu and Ahmed Hassan Awadallah and Ryen W. White and Doug Burger and Chi Wang
sources.mechanism: Customizable conversable agents combine language models, tools and human interaction.
sources.limitation: Conversation orchestration does not establish ontology consistency or favorable scaling.
sources.access: Version 2 full HTML inspected; cited version is the 2023 preprint

sources.title: Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?
sources.authors: Mert Cemri and Melissa Z. Pan and Shuyi Yang and Lakshya A. Agrawal and Bhavya Chopra and Rishabh Tiwari and Kurt Keutzer and Aditya Parameswaran and Dan Klein and Kannan Ramchandran and Matei Zaharia and Joseph E. Gonzalez and Ion Stoica
sources.mechanism: MAST distinguishes specification/design, inter-agent alignment, and verification/termination failures.
sources.limitation: A failure taxonomy is diagnostic, not a guarantee that a proposed ontology removes those failures.
sources.access: Version 3 full HTML inspected; revised October 26, 2025

sources.title: Towards a Science of Scaling Agent Systems
sources.authors: Yubin Kim and Ken Gu and Chanwoo Park and Chunjong Park and Samuel Schmidgall and A. Ali Heydari and Yao Yan and Zhihan Zhang and Yuchen Zhuang and Yun Liu and Mark Malhotra and Paul Pu Liang and Hae Won Park and Yuzhe Yang and Xuhai Xu and Yilun Du and Shwetak Patel and Tim Althoff and Daniel McDuff and Xin Liu
sources.mechanism: Controlled comparisons report task-dependent coordination effects and limitations of adding agents.
sources.limitation: These benchmark configurations do not establish the behavior of hundreds of agents using the proposed graph.
sources.access: Version 3 full HTML inspected; revised April 8, 2026

sources.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
sources.authors: John Yang and Carlos E. Jimenez and Alexander Wettig and Kilian Lieret and Shunyu Yao and Karthik Narasimhan and Ofir Press
sources.mechanism: Agent-computer interfaces expose repository navigation, editing and test execution as useful bounded actions.
sources.limitation: Single-system benchmark results do not validate this ontology-based multi-agent architecture.
sources.access: Full NeurIPS paper inspected
sources.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 37

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
sources.authors: Carlos E. Jimenez and John Yang and Alexander Wettig and Shunyu Yao and Kexin Pei and Ofir Press and Karthik Narasimhan
sources.mechanism: Repository-level issue resolution evaluated through executable tests offers a future testbed.
sources.limitation: Test-defined success is not comprehensive semantic correctness; contamination and task selection require controls.
sources.access: Original primary-paper abstract and indexed ICLR paper inspected
